blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Mati Bishop Abel Apigo was appointed by Pope Leo XIV as the new archbishop of Davao, succeeding Archbishop Romulo Valles, who already reached the mandatory retirement age for bishops, according to CBCP News. Apigo was appointed as the second bishop of Mati by Pope Francis in 2018. He completed his philosophical and theological studies at St. Francis Xavier Regional Major Seminary of Mindanao (SFX-REMASE) before being ordained a priest for the Archdiocese of Davao in 1994.
